name: worker_db_lock_wait
description: A lock request against a public relation has been waiting longer than the alert threshold, as observed by the worker's lock-wait monitor (services/worker/src/jobs/lock-wait-monitor.ts, cron /cron/lock-wait). This is the EARLY signal for the 2026-08-11 P0: the barrier on public.organizations formed at ~16:35 and user impact did not start until 16:40, so a lock-wait alarm buys ~4 minutes of lead time over the PGRST002 alarm. Emitted as a structured log line rather than a metric because the worker reaches Postgres through PostgREST and has no Cloud Monitoring metric surface of its own.

metricDescriptor.displayName: Worker-observed Postgres lock waits over threshold

labels.description: Fully-qualified relation the blocked request is waiting on, e.g. public.organizations.
Lock mode requested by the blocked backend, e.g. AccessExclusiveLock. AccessExclusiveLock on a hot table is the barrier-forming shape.
